ios.desc:
Today I Am a Tea Cup, what are you?

Quickly and effortlessly frame a positive outlook with Today I Am, your delightful companion app offering a unique experience every day. Discover your daily persona, from everyday objects like a bicycle or a tree. Each persona is paired with a personalized affirmation designed to uplift your spirits and set a positive tone for the day ahead.

Beyond daily inspiration, Today I Am stands out with its playful, imaginative approach to self-reflection. By inviting users to embrace different identities each day, the app fosters creativity, mindfulness, and a sense of wonder. Whether you're embodying a soaring eagle or a cozy blanket, Today I Am connects you to both the extraordinary and the everyday, making it a charming addition to your daily routine.

Features:
- Personalized Guidance: Access over 3,000 unique affirmations tailored to your energy and intentions.
- Daily Insights: Unlock affirmations infused with mystical joy for daily guidance.
- Intuitive Selection: Choose from categories like, spiritual growth and personal empowerment to match your mood and goals.
- On-Screen Widget: View your daily affirmation directly on your home or lock screen.
- Share Your Journey: Easily share affirmations with friends and fellow mindfulness seekers.
- Offline Access: Stay inspired even without an internet connection.


Start your day with a dose of positivity and inspiration with Today I Am!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Today I Am A – A Playful SwiftUI App for Daily Affirmations

quotes.text:
I aimed to create an app that efficiently adds a positive outlook to someone's day. Many people appreciate and enjoy a label, and I have personally benefited from daily affirmations. Combining these elements, I developed "Today I Am A: A Daily Persona" entirely in SwiftUI and SwiftData.

The app is designed to be opened at the start of each day, assigning users a unique persona. Each persona comes with a coordinated affirmation, merging your new identity with a positive outlook. Recently, I added HealthKit integration, widget support, and Apple Watch compatibility. Any and all feedback is greatly appreciated!

App Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/today-i-am-a-daily-persona/id6450616950
